name: Our Man in Theramore
summary: SI:7 seeks your help after a man washed ashore on Theramore Isle claims to be Varian Wrynn. Meet their agent Sully at the inn to learn what comes next.

sections.title: A Claim on Theramore
sections.body: SI:7 has heard that Jaina Proudmoore’s marines brought a man ashore on Theramore Isle. He says he is Varian Wrynn, the missing king of Stormwind. Their agent Sully is waiting at the inn, and SI:7 wants you to learn what is happening.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 want me in Theramore?
faq.answer: A man found washed ashore on Theramore Isle claims to be Varian Wrynn. SI:7 wants you to meet its agent Sully and find out what is happening.
Sully is a dwarf and an SI:7 agent stationed on Theramore Isle. He is waiting for you at the inn.
Jaina Proudmoore’s marines brought the man to Theramore after finding him washed up on the shore.

faq.q: What does the washed-up man claim?
faq.answer: He claims to be Varian Wrynn, the king of Stormwind.
Sully is waiting at the inn on Theramore Isle.
